text:
maya: Anyone else hitting redwoodctl login with the SSO agent dropping after ~30s when doing local testing? browser opens, I approve, then CLI says "auth: no token"

devon: yup saw that earlier today. mac or linux?

maya: macOS Ventura, installed via brew (0.9.2). flow opens browser, callback ok, then redwoodctl prints token saved but subsequent commands fail with no token.

samir: can you try with RCTL_DEBUG=1 and paste the output?

maya: here's the tail - looks like the agent dies: ```
2026-03-14T21:03:21Z sso-agent: start keepalive
2026-03-14T21:03:48Z sso-agent: keepalive failed: EOF
2026-03-14T21:03:48Z auth: writing profile failed: failed to acquire lock: resource busy
2026-03-14T21:03:48Z auth: token not found in keyring
```

devon: hmm `failed to acquire lock` suggests keyring or file lock contention. Are you running any helpers (e.g., 1password/gnome-keyring) or tmux?

maya: no tmux. I do have pass and gnome-keyring installed via homebrew, and I have iTerm running with fish.

samir: on mac we recently saw the macOS keyring prompt getting suppressed in certain TERM combos -> agent exits. fallback should be file-backed cache if keyring fails. I pushed a quick patch to try file cache with mode 0600 when keyring ops error. https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwoodctl/pull/289

lia: ops-bot, can you log an issue so we track a proper fix + docs?

ops-bot: Incident created: RCT-412 - redwoodctl SSO agent keepalive exit & keyring fallback. https://redwood.internal/incidents/RCT-412 :spiral_notepad:

devon: as a repro/workaround: `redwoodctl login --no-keyring` then export REDWOOD_TOKEN "<token>" and run `redwoodctl local-serve` — token sticks across local-serve restarts for me. not great but works.

maya: confirmed. built samir's branch locally, login succeeds and token persisted after restarting local-serve. :tada:

samir: follow-ups: add file-cache fallback, log clearer warning when keyring fails, add test for headless envs, and docs note about --no-keyring. I'll open a PR for tests and docs after the core change merges.

devon: also add troubleshooting section in CLI install guide: keyring caveats on mac, common envs that suppress prompts (CI, headless iTerm profiles, SSH).

maya: will open a small docs PR after lunch. thanks y'all. :thumbsup:
